jobs.occupation: We're Hiring: 2 Ventilation Installers / Diamond Drillers (Training Provided)
jobs.description:
Balling Ventilation – Denmark (Zealand & Funen)

Balling Ventilation is a busy Danish ventilation and contracting company based in Stenløse, working across Zealand (Sjælland) and Funen (Fyn). We install ventilation systems in homes and buildings – from single-room units and heat recovery systems (MVHR) to crawl space ventilation and radon mitigation – and we do a lot of diamond core drilling.

We are growing fast and need 2 new colleagues to start as soon as possible.

Who we're looking for

• 
Bricklayers (murere) who want to learn diamond core drilling and ventilation installation, or

• 
Other skilled trades (carpenters, electricians, plumbers, general construction workers, etc.) who are motivated to learn ventilation work and diamond drilling

No prior ventilation experience required – we will train you. What matters is that you are reliable, hardworking, and want to learn a skilled trade with great long-term prospects.

What we offer

• 
Hourly wage: 180–250 DKK depending on qualifications and experience

• 
+ 12.5% holiday pay (feriepenge) on top of your wage

• 
Your own company van and tools

• 
Plenty of work: minimum 160 hours per month guaranteed – and the opportunity to work 250+ hours per month if you want to, because we are very busy

• 
Full training in ventilation installation and diamond core drilling

• 
Varied work at different sites across Zealand and Funen

Requirements

• 
Skilled trade background (bricklayer or other construction trade)

• 
Willing to relocate to Denmark – we can help by referring you to housing options

• 
Basic English as a minimum (Danish not required)

• 
Valid driver's license

• 
Ready to work hard and learn new skills

How to apply

Send a short message about yourself and your work experience to:

Zakarias Balling Eddaif  ze@ballingventilation.dk  +45 71 72 75 79

We hire on an ongoing basis, so don't wait – reach out today.

jobs.occupation: Køkkenmedhjælper til Det Danske Madhus Albertslund/Kitchen Assistant for Our Production Facility in Albertslund
jobs.description:
Til vores produktion i Albertslund søger vi en struktureret og serviceminded kollega, der trives med at arbejde i et storkøkken, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og god stemning blandt kollegerne er i højsædet. 

Som køkkenmedarbejder hos Det Danske Madhus i Albertslund bliver du en vigtig del af vores team. 
Du får en spændende og varieret hverdag med opgaver såsom: 

• Produktion af kolde og varme retter
• Forefaldende arbejde i køkkenet
• Portionering af retter 
Hos Det Danske Madhus producerer vi dagligt mad til vores mange kunder. Vores kunder omfatter alt fra børn i institutioner og skoler til hjemmeboende ældre eller ældre på plejehjem. Vi mener at alle, uanset alder eller helbred fortjener et velsmagende måltid. 

Vi laver alt mad fra bunden, og opskrifterne er vores egne gennemprøvede opskrifter, så vi ved, vores kunder får måltider af højeste kvalitet. 

Hvem er du? 

Du har gerne tidligere erfaring med at arbejde i et køkken – fx på et hospital eller på et plejehjem. Du arbejder selvstændigt og trives i et miljø hvor der er travlt. 

Du har fokus på god hygiejne og høj kvalitet og du går ikke på kompromis med nogen af tingene. 

Du taler og skriver dansk på højt niveau. 

Hvad kan Det Danske Madhus tilbyde dig?

• Fantastiske kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold 
• Kantineordning med både morgenmad og frokost, der får dig godt igennem dagen 
• Et job omfattet af overenskomst med FOA og Kost og Ernæringsforbundet
• Attraktiv pensionsordning
• En personaleforening der står for hyggelige arrangementer, hvor vi sammen fejrer de små og store succeser
• Overskudsdeling, så du mærker, at din indsats gør en forskel 
Praktiske oplysninger

Du bliver en del af vores produktionsteam i Albertslund, hvor vi er ca. 90 medarbejdere. 

Stillingen er 37 timer pr. uge. Du arbejder mandag til fredag i tidsrummet mellem 6.00-15.00.

Lyder det som noget for dig? 

Så send os dit CV og ansøgning hurtigst muligt via ”ansøg-knappen”

Annoncen er aktiv og vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send dit cv allerede i dag. 

Har du nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Madhuschef Kim Knudsen på mail kik@ddm.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

 

ENGLISH:

For our production facility in Albertslund, we are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who thrives in a large-scale kitchen environment where quality, teamwork, and a positive working atmosphere are top priorities.

As a Kitchen Assistant at Det Danske Madhus in Albertslund, you will become an important part of our team.

You will enjoy an exciting and varied workday with tasks including:

Preparing hot and cold meals
General kitchen duties
Portioning and packaging meals

At Det Danske Madhus, we prepare meals every day for our many customers. Our customers range from children in daycare centres and schools to elderly people living at home or in nursing homes. We believe that everyone, regardless of age or health, deserves a delicious and nutritious meal.

All our food is made from scratch using our own tried and tested recipes, ensuring that our customers receive meals of the highest quality.

Who Are You?

Ideally, you have previous experience working in a kitchen environment, for example in a hospital, nursing home, or similar setting.

You are able to work independently and thrive in a busy workplace.

You have a strong focus on hygiene and quality, and you never compromise on either.

You are fluent in spoken and written Danish.

What Can Det Danske Madhus Offer You?
Fantastic colleagues and a strong sense of team spirit
A staff canteen offering both breakfast and lunch to keep you energized throughout the day
Employment covered by collective agreements with FOA and The Danish Association of Dietitians and Nutrition Professionals
An attractive pension scheme
A staff association that organizes social events where we celebrate both small and large successes together
A profit-sharing scheme, ensuring that you feel the impact of your contribution
Practical Information

You will become part of our production team in Albertslund, consisting of approximately 90 employees.

This is a full-time position (37 hours per week). Working hours are Monday to Friday between 6:00 AM and 3:00 PM.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

Then send us your CV and application as soon as possible via the "Apply" button.

The position is open, and we review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV today.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Kitchen Manager Kim Knudsen at kik@ddm.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

jobs.occupation: Er du massør med passion for dit fag? Bliv en del af CityFys i Kalundborg! Are you a massage therapist with a passion for your profession? Join CityFys in Kalundborg!
jobs.description:
Hos CityFys søger vi en engageret og dygtig massør til vores virksomhedsordninger i Kalundborg – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring! Vi er på udkig efter en passioneret massør, der ønsker at arbejde i et udviklende og støttende miljø, hvor du kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Hvorfor CityFys?

Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Faste og attraktive behandlingsdage i CityFys’ virksomhedsordninger og i egen klinik

• 
Mulighed for ekstra vikaropgaver og fleksible timer

• 
Gratis og løbende efteruddannelse, herunder kurser i triggerpunkter, ergonomi, stretching og meget mere. Læs om kurserne her: CityFys kurser

• 
Fordelagtige vilkår, inklusiv fitness- og sundhedsordning

• 
Fleksibel aflønning – enten per faktura eller som dataløn

• 
Løbende support og sparring, så du kan udvikle dig i dit tempo

Er du klar til at tage din karriere som massør til næste niveau?

Send din ansøgning via vores hjemmeside: http://cityfys.dk/søg-job/  
Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til os på tlf. 70 200 726.

Om CityFys:
CityFys A/S er Danmarks største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen København og Water & Wellness Randers.

 

English version:

At CityFys, we are looking for an engaged and skilled masseur for our corporate programs in Kalundborg – whether you're newly graduated or have several years of experience! We are seeking a passionate masseur who wants to work in a supportive and developmental environment where you can make a difference for our clients.

Why CityFys?

As a masseur at CityFys, you’ll have great freedom with responsibility and flexible working hours, allowing you to adapt your work to your life. We believe in continuous development and encourage you to experiment with different massage techniques tailored to each client’s unique needs. With us, you will become part of our "small-BIG family" – a team of professional therapists who work closely together to create the best experience for our clients.

We value both personal and professional growth, and we create a work environment where your passion for helping others is recognized and rewarded.

At CityFys, our goal is to be Denmark's best workplace for masseurs and to deliver high-quality treatments to our clients.

We offer:

• 
Fixed and attractive treatment days in CityFys’ corporate programs and in oue own clinic

• 
Opportunity for additional substitute work and flexible hours

• 
Free and ongoing further education, including courses in trigger points, ergonomics, stretching, and much more. Read about the courses here: CityFys courses

• 
Beneficial conditions, including fitness and health plans

• 
Flexible compensation – either per invoice or as salary

• 
Ongoing support and guidance, allowing you to develop at your own pace

Are you ready to take your career as a masseur to the next level?

Send your application via our website: CityFys Job Postings
We offer quick onboarding and look forward to hearing from you!

Have any questions? Call us at +45 70 200 726.

About CityFys:
CityFys A/S is Denmark's largest provider of massage services and serves some of the country's largest companies. We have been in the industry since 1999 and run our own wellness departments at DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen Copenhagen, and Water & Wellness Randers.

jobs.occupation: Truck Drivers Wanted – Day & Night Shifts | Nordline Transport ApS
jobs.description:
Nordline Transport ApS is looking for reliable and responsible truck drivers for permanent routes on both day and night shifts.

We are a growing transport company and are currently expanding our team. We are looking for professional drivers who take pride in their work and can be trusted to deliver a reliable service to our customers.

The positions involve regular truck driving on planned routes with fixed and predictable assignments.

We are currently hiring for both day and night shifts.

Your responsibilities

• 
Driving trucks on fixed and scheduled routes

• 
Transport and delivery of goods

• 
Loading and unloading when required

• 
Safe and correct handling of goods

• 
Daily inspection of the vehicle

• 
Compliance with applicable driving and rest-time regulations

• 
Professional and reliable service to our customers and partners

• 
Taking responsibility for the vehicle and goods during your shift

We expect you to

• 
Hold a valid Category C driving licence

• 
Preferably hold a Category CE driving licence

• 
Hold a valid EU Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (Driver CPC)

• 
Hold a valid digital tachograph driver card

• 
Be reliable, punctual and responsible

• 
Be able to work independently

• 
Take good care of the vehicle and equipment

• 
Have a professional attitude towards customers and colleagues

• 
Be able to communicate in English or Danish

• 
Previous experience as a truck driver is an advantage, but the right attitude and reliability are equally important

Working hours

We are hiring drivers for both day and night shifts.

Working hours depend on the specific route and will be agreed upon during the recruitment process.

Please state in your application whether you are interested in day shifts, night shifts, or both.

We offer

• 
Full-time employment

• 
Fixed and scheduled routes

• 
Stable working conditions

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and applicable employment terms

• 
Modern and well-maintained trucks

• 
A professional working environment with short decision-making processes

• 
The opportunity to join a growing transport company

• 
Long-term employment opportunities for the right candidates

Application

If you are interested in joining Nordline Transport ApS, please send us a short application including information about your previous driving experience, driving licence categories and relevant certificates.

Please specify whether you are applying for day or night shifts.

Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Employment: Full-time

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as suitable candidates are found.

Nordline Transport ApS

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.occupation: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.

jobs.occupation: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.

About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

• Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
• Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
• Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
• Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
• Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
• Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.
The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

• The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
• The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
• A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
• A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
• A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
• The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.

Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

• A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
• A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
• Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
• Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
• Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
• Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
• Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English.
• Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
• Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.
It is also important that you have:

• Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
• Strategic thinking.
• Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
• Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
• Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
• and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.

Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.

More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.
